_doc: Open-vocabulary 'find anything' (Phase 4): concepts NOT in senses.json. CLIP ranks chips for the text (top_k_chips county-wide; every chip in a place up to place_max_chips, CLIP-ranked) → Grounding DINO boxes the concept in each chip → SAM 2.1 masks each box → verifier (area range per concept when known, else the detector score) → dedupe by distance. eye_precision = the measured pre-test (hits that are right out of 12), shown as 'low confidence' below low_confidence_below.
eye_precision_doc: Eye-checked right-out-of-12 (top 12, county-wide CLIP top 500 chips), 2026-11-07, with clip_verify + clip_mask_to_box (run B). Baseline run A without them: tennis 4, basketball 2, golf 6, cemetery 1, water tower 4, crane 4, bus lot 9, baseball 6, boat dock 12, trampoline 0 (48/108 on the 9 re-run); B = 53/108. Sheets: data/out/openvocab_*_base.png vs *_B.png.
